function.description: Recall YOUR OWN recent activity — the goals, cron jobs, and chats you ran, newest-first, with outcome and spend. USE THIS (not the filesystem, not notes) for 'what did I do', 'what ran since X', 'what have I been up to'. Optional `since` ('8h'/'2d'/ISO), `kind` ('goal'/'cron'/'chat'), `limit` (1-20).
function.name: recent_activity
